summary:
Frontend-only verification of new Add-to-Cart feature. Structural placement is correct on BOTH Product Card (compact circular cart icon on each of 36 product cards, testID `product-card-add-to-cart-<slug>`) and Product Detail (`product-add-to-cart-button` rendered NEXT TO `product-request-quote-button` — both visible and interactive). Card body still navigates to /product/<slug> (regression PASS). Request-Quote flow still routes to /(tabs)/rfq with productSlug/productName/category params (regression PASS). Bottom-tab layout untouched, cart badge component present with testID `tab-cart-badge`. Toast component present in DOM tree (ToastProvider mounted inside CartProvider in _layout.tsx). 

CRITICAL BUG: The unauthenticated 'prompt sign-in instead of failing silently' behavior is broken on RN Web. `useAddToCartAction.promptSignIn()` calls React Native's `Alert.alert(...)`, but `react-native-web/dist/exports/Alert/index.js` implements Alert.alert as a NO-OP (`class Alert { static alert() {} }`). Tapping the compact Add-to-Cart on any product card OR the Add-to-Cart button on the Product Detail screen while signed out produces ZERO feedback — no browser dialog, no window.alert call, no window.confirm call, no DOM alert, no console log, no navigation, no toast. This is the exact silent-failure the problem statement forbids. Verified twice with alert()/confirm() monkey-patching and page.on('dialog') listener. E1's testing note claimed 'RN Alert may render as a browser alert dialog' — this is incorrect for the installed react-native-web version; Alert.alert is a static no-op.

Could not test the signed-in happy path (POST /api/me/cart/add → toast + badge increment): the upstream /api/auth/send-otp does not return a demoOtp for any tested email (customer@test.com, customer@demo.com, demo@customer.com etc.) — real inbox delivery is required and dev preview does not expose the code. E1/main-agent should verify the signed-in flow manually or expose a demo email that returns demoOtp.

ui_bugs.issue: On React Native Web, `Alert.alert(...)` is a NO-OP (react-native-web ships an empty Alert.alert). Result: tapping Add-to-Cart while signed out silently does nothing — no dialog, no navigation, no toast, no console output. This violates the requirement 'prompt sign-in instead of failing silently'. Fix suggestion: detect `Platform.OS === 'web'` and either (a) call `showToast('Please sign in to add items', {type:'info'})` + `router.push('/(tabs)/account')`, or (b) use `window.confirm(...)` on web, or (c) show a small in-app modal via a shared confirm context.

integration_issues.issue: Silent no-op on web because RN Alert isn't implemented in react-native-web. See ui_bug above.

issues: Add to Cart and Request Quote are placed side-by-side in the sticky footer (styles.ctaRow, gap: spacing.sm). Both render as full-width halves at 390px viewport, well above the 44pt tap target. Visual balance looks correct.

Compact 34x34 rounded add-to-cart button sits in the metaRow next to price. hitSlop of 8px on all sides bumps effective tap target to ~50x50, meeting 44pt minimum. Icon is white on brand color — good contrast.

react_native_issues.issue: react-native-web Alert.alert is a no-op — do not rely on Alert.alert for user-facing prompts in the web preview. Reference: /app/frontend/src/hooks/useAddToCartAction.ts:29 and /app/frontend/node_modules/react-native-web/dist/exports/Alert/index.js

action_items: HIGH: Replace `Alert.alert(...)` in useAddToCartAction.promptSignIn with a web-safe prompt. Recommended: `if (Platform.OS === 'web') { showToast('Please sign in to add items to your cart', { type: 'info' }); router.push('/(tabs)/account'); return; } Alert.alert(...)` — this keeps the native experience and gives web users an actual visible cue.

OPTIONAL: Verify authenticated Add-to-Cart happy path (upstream POST /api/me/cart/add → toast `<name> added to cart` + `tab-cart-badge` increment) — testing agent could not obtain an OTP via preview API. Please self-test with a real email that receives OTP or add a dev-only email whitelist that returns demoOtp.
OPTIONAL: Console still logs `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents` and `"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"` — noise from library, not this feature.
critical_code_review_comments: Provider ordering in app/_layout.tsx is correct: SafeAreaProvider → AppProvider → CartProvider → ToastProvider → Stack. So useCart and useToast are available inside useAddToCartAction. Good.
useAddToCartAction handles double-tap via `pendingKey` and escalates auth-shaped errors to promptSignIn — logic is sound; only the promptSignIn transport is broken on web.
ProductCard uses `e.stopPropagation?.()` on the compact button's onPress so tapping the cart icon does NOT trigger the card's navigation. Verified in code and behavior.
CartContext.addToCart is used unchanged (same code path as cart screen). No regression risk to /(tabs)/cart, /(tabs)/rfq, or tabs layout.

product/[slug].tsx footer now has ctaRow with cartCta + rfqCta side-by-side; existing testID `product-request-quote-button` is preserved and its onPress navigation to /(tabs)/rfq with params is unchanged (regression PASS).

success_rate.frontend: 70% (structural placement PASS; signed-out UX FAIL on web; signed-in path untested due to no OTP access)

context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) react-native-web Alert.alert is a no-op — verified at /app/frontend/node_modules/react-native-web/dist/exports/Alert/index.js. Any RN Alert-based prompt is silently dropped on web. 2) To reach the signed-in happy path, either whitelist an email that returns demoOtp from /api/auth/send-otp or intercept the network response. The Playwright script in this iteration monkey-patches window.alert/confirm and listens for page.on('dialog') — reuse that pattern. 3) Product cards render 36 items on /(tabs)/products; each has both `product-card-<slug>` (whole card) and `product-card-add-to-cart-<slug>` (compact button). 4) tab-cart-badge only renders when cart.itemCount > 0 — assert its existence AFTER a successful add, not before.
rca_of_issue: Root cause: `useAddToCartAction.promptSignIn()` uses `Alert.alert()` from 'react-native'. On the Expo web preview this resolves to `react-native-web`'s Alert stub which is defined as `class Alert { static alert() {} }` (empty function). Therefore the two-button 'Sign in required / Not now / Sign in' dialog is never displayed, and no fallback (navigation, toast, console) is triggered. Reproduction: (1) Open /(tabs)/products in the web preview while signed out. (2) Tap any compact cart-icon button (testID product-card-add-to-cart-<slug>). (3) Observe: no dialog, no toast, no navigation, no error — silent no-op. Same on /product/<slug> Add-to-Cart button. Mitigation: gate the Alert.alert path on Platform.OS !== 'web' and use showToast + router.push('/(tabs)/account') for the web branch.
